text:
Lottery Results Today Live, July 17, 2025: Punjab, Manipur, Sikkim, Goa & Arunachal Winning Numbers
Live July 17, 2025 Lottery Results: Check the full list of winning numbers for Punjab, Manipur, Goa, Sikkim, and Arunachal Pradesh state lottery here.
Live July 17, 2025 Lottery Results: Lotteries in Punjab, Manipur, Goa and Arunachal Pradesh remain a popular pursuit among hopeful participants from cities and villages alike, each dreaming of a life-changing prize. With distinct draws held daily at different times, these states provide regular opportunities for individuals to test their luck. Here’s a detailed overview of the upcoming lottery draws across each region.

Punjab State Dear 10 Platinum Thursday Weekly Lottery Scheme
This lottery is officially authorised for sale in Punjab and in other Indian states where lottery operations are legally permitted.
- First Prize: Rs 1 Lakh
- Number of Tickets: 1,00,000 tickets distributed across ten series (90 to 99), each series running from 0000 to 9999
- Ticket Price: Rs 10 per ticket (inclusive of all applicable taxes)
- Draw Schedule: Draws are conducted every Saturday at 6:00 PM in Ludhiana, beginning October 7, 2023. The Director of Punjab State Lotteries holds the authority to alter the date, time, or venue if necessary.
Prize Claim & Payment Process
For prizes exceeding Rs 10,000, claims must be submitted within 30 days of result publication in the Punjab Government Gazette.
Claimants must complete the official prize claim form and submit it to:
Director, Punjab State Lotteries
Vit te Yojna Bhawan, Plot No. 2B, Sector 33-A, Chandigarh – 160020
Submission methods include
- Personal delivery
- Through a nationalised bank
- By registered post
- Via insured parcel
Claims submitted after the 30-day deadline will be processed as per the Punjab State Lotteries Regulation Rules, 2015, and any other relevant legal provisions.
Manipur State Lottery
The Manipur State Lottery runs four draws every day as part of its Weekly Lottery scheme, with results announced at the following times:
- 12:00 PM – Singam Morning
- 4:00 PM – Singam Day
- 7:00 PM – Singam Evening
- 9:00 PM – Singam Night
Each draw features a grand prize of Rs 27 lakh, along with additional cash rewards for second to fifth place winners. A consolation prize of Rs 10,000 is also awarded across all series.
Lottery tickets are affordably priced at Rs 6 and are available through authorised retailers. Each ticket includes a unique alphanumeric code that consists of:
- Two digits (ranging from 70 to 90)
- One alphabet (from A to K)
- A five-digit number (from 00000 to 99999)
- Example ticket format: 83B 87219
How to Check the Manipur State Lottery Results:
- Visit the official website: manipurlotteries.com
- Navigate to the ‘Today Lottery Result’ section
- Click on the “Manipur Lottery Result" link
- Select ‘View Result’
- Match your ticket number with the list of winning numbers displayed

The first prize is Rs 10,000, and with tickets priced at just Rs 10, it offers an affordable opportunity to win attractive cash rewards.
